headline: Public hearing and approval vote on the Adams Point Tax Increment Financing amendment, plus a Lester B. Orcutt Blvd. traffic recommendation.
summary: Other items include a traffic calming project agreement, a mayoral committee appointment, and a Small Business Saturday proclamation. Public comment periods and a city manager report are also listed.
